intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Julian opens the binder to a tab labeled DOCUMENTATION, then to a sub-tab labeled ALSO DOCUMENTATION.

teach0.speaker: java
teach0.text: Today's subject is comments. Every well-run program keeps minutes, and comments are those minutes.

teach1.speaker: java
teach1.text: Two slashes comment out the rest of a line. A slash and an asterisk open a block comment, and an asterisk and a slash close it.

teach2.speaker: java
teach2.text: And a slash with two asterisks begins a documentation comment, like the one at the top of this file. Those are my favorite. They are very formal.

passed.speaker: java
passed.text: The program compiles, and the note is preserved for the record. Excellent work, {player}. I'm adding this to the minutes.

failed.speaker: java
failed.text: The compiler has rejected this. That's alright. We will review it again, line by line.

bye.speaker: java
bye.text: Motion to adjourn accepted. We'll reconvene at a later date.
